title: fix(ai): capture initial request errors in Anthropic messages.stream()

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+pypi/posthog: patch
+---
+
+`posthog.ai.anthropic`: `messages.stream()` (sync and async) now captures an `$ai_generation` event with `$ai_is_error` when the initial request fails, for example with a 401 or a connection error. Before, only `messages.create(stream=True)` captured that failure, so errors raised on entering the `stream()` context manager were never reported.

@@ -140,7 +140,28 @@ def stream(
 
         def tracked_request():
             start_time = time.time()
-            response = request()
+            try:
+                response = request()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                accumulator = _AnthropicStreamAccumulator()
+                try:
+                    self._capture_streaming_event(
+                        posthog_distinct_id,
+                        posthog_trace_id,
+                        posthog_properties,
+                        posthog_privacy_mode,
+                        posthog_groups,
+                        kwargs,
+                        accumulator.usage_stats,
+                        time.time() - start_time,
+                        accumulator.content_blocks,
+                        accumulator.accumulated_content,
+                        error=exc,
+                    )
+                except Exception:
+                    # Telemetry must never replace the provider's own error.
+                    _log.warning("[PostHog] Failed to capture streaming connect error")
+                raise
             return self._track_streaming_response(
                 response,
                 posthog_distinct_id,

@@ -2274,6 +2274,26 @@ def test_messages_stream_preserves_native_manager_helpers_close_and_tracking(
     assert "posthog_distinct_id" not in client.post.call_args.kwargs
 
 
+def test_messages_stream_captures_initial_request_error(mock_client):
+    client = Anthropic(api_key="test-key", posthog_client=mock_client)
+    client.post = Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("401 unauthorized"))
+
+    manager = client.messages.stream(
+        model="claude-haiku-4-5",
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Foo"}],
+        max_tokens=1,
+        posthog_distinct_id="test-user",
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="401 unauthorized"):
+        with manager:
+            pass
+
+    assert mock_client.capture.call_count == 1
+    props = mock_client.capture.call_args.kwargs["properties"]
+    assert props["$ai_is_error"] is True
+    assert props["$ai_error"] == "401 unauthorized"
+
+
